description: Loaner scope tracking — check-out, check-in, and open loaner list. Scopes owned by a loaner client (e.g. TSI LOANER) are tracked through tblLoanerTran for each check-out/in cycle.

sections.name: Loaner List (main grid)
sections.description: Table of scopes belonging to the loaner client, showing scope type, serial, and current status (In / Out / Repair)

fields.label: Loaner Client
fields.notes: Header label — the client whose scopes are tracked as loaners (e.g. TSI LOANER)

fields.label: Scope Type
fields.notes: Grid column — model number like 0502-276-030

fields.label: Serial #
fields.notes: Grid column

fields.label: Status
fields.notes: Derived field — computed from tblLoanerTran: if sDateOut is set and sDateIn is null → 'Out'; if linked to active repair → 'Repair'; else → 'In'

sections.name: Loaner Detail (below grid)
sections.description: Read-only details for the selected loaner scope, showing the most recent check-out transaction

fields.label: Loaned to
fields.notes: Client/department the scope was loaned to, shown as 'HCA Florida South Tampa Hospital - FL'

fields.label: Loaned on (date)
fields.notes: Date of check-out; stored as string, displayed as date

fields.label: Department (line 2)
fields.notes: Second line shows department name (e.g. 'Accoutns Payable')

fields.label: Sub-department (line 3)
fields.notes: Third line shows sub-department or facility (e.g. 'Sterile Processing'); may be a second department field or free text

fields.label: Company
fields.notes: Company associated with the loaner transaction (e.g. 'Total Scope, Inc')

fields.label: Contact
fields.notes: Contact name from the department record (e.g. 'Brian Kenney')

fields.label: P.O. #
fields.notes: Purchase order number; shown as 'TBD' or 'NA' when not set

fields.label: Delivery Method
fields.notes: Carrier name (e.g. 'United Parcel Service')

fields.label: Recorded by
fields.notes: Username who created the transaction (e.g. 'bmchugh')

fields.label: Recorded on
fields.notes: Date the transaction was created (e.g. '04/10/2026')

fields.label: Owner
fields.notes: Shown below Recorded by; appears to be blank in screenshots — may be an unused field or scope owner reference

sections.name: Check Out Dialog
sections.description: Modal for checking out a loaner scope to a customer department

fields.label: Department
fields.notes: Two-part: department name + office/location suffix

fields.label: Company
fields.notes: Company associated with the check-out

fields.label: Delivery Method
fields.notes: Carrier for outbound shipment

fields.label: Sales Rep
fields.notes: Sales rep (e.g. 'House Account')

fields.label: P.O. #
fields.notes: Purchase order number

fields.label: On-Site Loaner
fields.notes: Checkbox — marks if loaner stays on-site at customer facility

fields.label: Tracking #
fields.notes: Outbound shipment tracking number

fields.label: Date and Time
fields.notes: Check-out date + time; pre-populated with current datetime; stored as string

sections.name: Check In Dialog
sections.description: Modal for checking in a returned loaner scope

fields.label: Department
fields.notes: Pre-populated from the check-out record; two-part display

fields.label: Company
fields.notes: Pre-populated from check-out record

fields.label: Delivery Method
fields.notes: Pre-populated; carrier for return shipment

fields.label: Sales Rep
fields.notes: Pre-populated from check-out record

fields.label: P.O. #
fields.notes: Pre-populated from check-out record

fields.label: On-Site Loaner
fields.notes: Pre-populated from scope record

fields.label: Tracking #
fields.notes: Return shipment tracking number

fields.label: Date and Time
fields.notes: Check-in date + time; pre-populated with current datetime

fields.label: Rack #
fields.notes: Only on Check In dialog (not Check Out) — rack position where scope is stored after return

sections.name: Dialog Actions
sections.description: Action buttons on both Check Out and Check In dialogs

fields.label: Save
fields.notes: Saves the check-out or check-in transaction

fields.label: Repair
fields.action: Creates a repair record from the loaner scope
fields.notes: Links to tblLoanerTran.lRepairKey; creates a new repair for the scope

fields.label: Cancel
fields.notes: Dismisses the dialog

fields.label: Label
fields.notes: Generates a shipping label; likely uses tblShippingUPS_Loaners data
